name: Keys And Knives (The Starry Night)
desc:
Welcome to Keys And Knives (The Starry Night)

When the gumball drops, you're either a Red Team or a Blue Team.

Red Team:
- Eliminate all blue team players before they escape.

Blue Team:
- Use the key to open the door.
- Avoid red team players at all costs.

👍1000 LIKES FOR 2 X COINS!
